app.name: Online Chat
shutdown.title: Server closed
shutdown.body: The server has been shut down. Please wait for it to restart, then reopen the web chat.
login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to chat with players on the Minecraft server.
login.registrationClosed: Registration is closed on this server.
login.kicked: Your account signed in on another device, so this session was signed out.
login.reason.passwordChanged: Your password was changed, so this session was signed out. Please sign in with the new password.
account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Manage your Minecraft binding, two-factor protection and password.
account.twofa.title: Two-factor sign-in
account.twofa.label: Require web confirmation when joining the server
account.twofa.hint: After joining, you are frozen until you open the link shown in chat and confirm from this signed-in browser.
account.twofa.unavailable: The server administrator has not enabled two-factor authentication.
account.twofa.needBind: Bind a Minecraft player first to enable two-factor sign-in.
account.twofa.confirmOn: Turn on two-factor sign-in? Every time you join the server you will need to confirm from a browser that is signed in to this web account. If you cannot confirm within the time limit you will be kicked.
account.password.title: Change password
account.password.ok: Password updated. Other devices have been signed out.
account.delete.title: Delete account
account.delete.body: Deleting your account unbinds your Minecraft player, turns off two-factor sign-in and signs you out everywhere. This cannot be undone.
account.delete.confirm: Permanently delete the account "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
twofa.title: Confirm your sign-in
twofa.subtitle: A Minecraft player bound to your account is waiting to be let in.
twofa.confirm.body: Only approve if you just joined the server with this player. If it wasn't you, reject to kick them.
twofa.approve: Yes, it's me — let me in
twofa.reject: That's not me — kick the player
twofa.ok: {player} has been let in. You can close this page.
twofa.rejected: {player} was kicked. Consider changing your Minecraft account password.
twofa.err.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has already been used.
twofa.err.expired: This confirmation request has expired and the player was kicked. Rejoin the server to get a new link.
twofa.err.unavailable: Two-factor authentication is not enabled on this server.
twofa.err.mismatch: The player {player} is not bound to the account you are signed in as ({user}). Sign in with the right account, or the player will be kicked when the request times out.
twofa.err.wrongAccount: This browser is signed in to a different account, so the player was kicked.
bind.title: Bind Minecraft player
bind.subtitle: Link your web account to your Minecraft account so messages appear under your in-game name.
bind.pending: Waiting for {name} to click [Yes] in game…
bind.err.offline: That player is not online, or the name is unknown.
bind.err.already: That Minecraft account is already bound to another web user.
bind.howto.1: Enter your in-game name and click Request binding.
bind.howto.2: You must be online on the Minecraft server.
bind.howto.3: A prompt appears in your in-game chat with a code and [Yes]/[No] buttons.
bind.howto.4: Click [Yes]. The binding completes here automatically.
chat.title: Chat
chat.err.notBound: You can chat without binding, but your messages will show your web username instead of your Minecraft name.
chat.forceLogout: Your account signed in on another device, so you were signed out here.
error.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
